host_quiescence: Primary chat explicitly authorized sequential measurement after successful release gate; other repository JVM builds/profilers paused until all eight JVMs completed. External OS activity was not controlled.
timing_windows: Whole main frame HEAD through next HEAD, including native wait owner continuations. Setup, settling, warmup and digest serialization excluded. Process CPU includes background JVM work.
allocation_scope: Main and simulation worker thread allocation only; not whole-process allocation or live heap.
raw_frames: Unfiltered per-frame records remain in ignored raw build/replay-analysis JSON files; this committed compact evidence retains raw SHA-256, every warmup/measured trial and aggregates.
